name: @extas/inventory
description: Inventory and ERP sync (S09): the ERP mode switch (PR 497), the ERP-absent guard (PR 499), the sync layer with retry, backoff and the error surface (PR 194), the stock pull per SKU / colour / size (PR 195), company and warehouse mapping per store (PR 196) and stock locations with the damaged bin (PR 201), on the generic ERP adapter (PR 498, @extas/adapters).
